item.title: How to build a top data engineering team
item.description: Building a data engineering team that the business trusts requires more than technical skills. Here's what I've learned about team structure, hiring bar, ownership models, and the design patterns that make data pipelines reliable—including a deep dive into SAP Data Services architecture and automation.
